item.title: New Hampshire Democratic Socialist Candidate Hesitates on Endorsing Moderate Senate Nominee
item.description: Karishma Manzur, a progressive candidate for the U.S. Senate in New Hampshire, did not confirm support for Rep. Chris Pappas if he wins the Democratic primary.
